newsitem.title: USA: Premier sees write-offs in EyeSys deal.
newsitem.headline: Premier sees write-offs in EyeSys deal.

text.p: Premier Laser Systems Inc said Wednesday it anticipates writing off as much of the purchase price of EyeSys Technologies as possible to adjust in-process research and development to its fair-market value.
The write-off will be reported in the fiscal second quarter ending September 30, the company said.
The acquisition of Houston-based EyeSys, announced in April, awaits regulatory approvals.
Premier said it now anticipates the acquisition will close in mid-September.

Premier develops, manufactures and markets several lines of proprietary medical and dental lasers, fiber optic delivery systems and associated products for a variety of dental, ophthalmic, dermatological and surgical applications.
